value.title: Overall: where his game is
value.description: Talented natural — strong amateur floor (at a college club competition beat every non-team player, lost to every team player; clean line = genuinely strong raw chess). Ceiling he hit = a training gap, not a talent gap (openings as understanding, practiced endgames, patient conversion). 20-year dormancy, lightly maintained — instinct rusty not cold. Conflict-sensitivity is load-bearing: here to LEARN, not compete. Continuing rule: go at the pace his body says yes to; if anything tightens, stop. The lean to watch: his may be over-caution / conflict-flinch (mine is moving too fast on instinct).

value.title: Thread: gentlest diagnosis next session
value.description: Open with the gentlest diagnosis: put up a quiet position, 'what do you see?' — read his board vision with zero contest. Also ask his lichess/chess.com handle (unblocks #13417, gives a real shared board now).
